disclaimer: All rules are experimental non-clinical research heuristics for fictional software validation. They do not constitute certified medical triage or diagnostic advice.

rules.name: Immediate Emergency Safety Override
rules.description: Explicit breathing difficulty, respiratory arrest, cardiac emergency, or direct ambulance requests immediately escalate assessed urgency to Extreme and trigger emergency safety protocols regardless of self-reported severity.
rules.source_reference: NHS Shortness of breath triage guidance & India ERSS 112 protocol.

rules.name: Unresolved Contradiction Abstention
rules.description: When confirmed evidence contains self-contradictory symptom states or irreconcilable conflict, urgency assessment abstains with status unable_to_assess.

rules.name: Missing or Empty Evidence Abstention
rules.description: When no positive symptoms are confirmed or context is missing (age/sex unknown), urgency assessment abstains with status unable_to_assess.

rules.name: Pediatric Age < 2 with Fever Escalation
rules.description: Infants and young children under 2 years of age presenting with confirmed fever are evaluated with minimum High urgency due to rapid decompensation risk.
rules.source_reference: NICE Clinical Guideline CG160: Fever in under 5s.

rules.name: Geriatric Age >= 65 with Multiple Systemic Symptoms
rules.description: Older adults presenting with fever combined with pain or dizziness are evaluated with minimum High urgency.
rules.source_reference: Emergency Severity Index (ESI) Implementation Handbook v4.

rules.name: Patient-Reported Extreme Functional Impact
rules.description: Patient self-reports extreme discomfort that is extremely difficult to tolerate, escalating baseline urgency to Extreme if systemic symptoms are confirmed.
rules.source_reference: Visual Analog Scale & Patient-Reported Functional Impairment Metrics.

rules.name: Patient-Reported High Functional Impact
rules.description: Patient self-reports symptoms significantly affecting normal functioning with multiple confirmed symptoms, yielding High urgency.

rules.name: Moderate Discomfort Interfering with Activities
rules.description: Confirmed symptoms interfering with daily activities with moderate symptom load, yielding Medium urgency.

rules.name: Mild Discomfort with Normal Functioning
rules.description: Isolated mild symptoms where normal activities are possible and no systemic red flags exist, yielding Low urgency.

rules.name: Severity Uncertainty Conservative Assessment
rules.description: When patient is unsure of severity, urgency is derived conservatively from confirmed objective symptoms and age risk factors without penalizing uncertainty.
rules.source_reference: Conservative Triage Decision Rules under Uncertainty.
